timing: before model implementation completion, synthetic tests, GPU smoke, formal training, or new validation access
reason: freeze projector initialization, KAS numeric precision, paired-process audit, optimizer/checkpoint contract, bootstrap and source-code boundaries

projector_initialization.device: construct on CPU before moving model to target CUDA device
projector_initialization.rng_isolation: use a CPU RNG fork/dedicated manual seed for projector reset, then reset all training RNG to20260860 after every module/optimizer/loader is constructed
projector_initialization.algorithm: torch.nn.Conv3d(128,1,1,bias=true) default reset_parameters: kaiming_uniform weight with a=sqrt(5), bias uniform +/-1/sqrt(128)

numeric_precision.kas_losses: cast projected x and final z to float32 before MSE, sigmoid, Dice, negative, cosine and logsumexp
numeric_precision.contrastive: temperature1; mean softplus((cos_neg-cos_pos)/1) which is algebraically identical to stable two-logit InfoNCE
numeric_precision.detach: none anywhere in the KAS graph

optimizer_exact_contract.checkpoint_loading: load KD200 student model state only; do not load any old optimizer state
optimizer_exact_contract.control_group: single ordered parameter group containing student parameters
optimizer_exact_contract.kas_group: single ordered parameter group: student parameters first, projector weight then bias
optimizer_exact_contract.optimizer: AdamW lr1e-5 weight_decay1e-5 betas[0.9,0.999] eps1e-8 amsgrad=false maximize=false foreach=false fused=false capturable=false
optimizer_exact_contract.gradient_clip: global norm5 over the complete arm optimizer parameter sequence including KAS projector

loader_and_pairing.tensor_hash: SHA256 over CPU contiguous C-order bytes; dtype and shape stored beside hash
loader_and_pairing.initial_student_state: SHA256 over sorted deploy state keys followed by each contiguous tensor dtype,shape,raw bytes; require arms equal
first_batch: ordered case IDs and newline-joined SHA256
every_epoch: SHA256 of ordered case IDs over all 94 batches
local CUDA RNG-state SHA256 immediately before first augmentation
local CUDA RNG-state SHA256 after final optimizer step
loader_and_pairing.pair_gate: all above initial/first-batch/per-epoch values must exactly match control and KAS

checkpoint_contract.kas: deploy-only model_state_dict plus full kas_training_state_dict containing student and projector, plus metadata
checkpoint_contract.projector_gate: projector keys present in kas_training_state_dict, optimizer parameter list and gradient audit
checkpoint_contract.reload: all four control and four KAS checkpoints strict reload; KAS full wrapper and stripped plain student produce identical final logits
checkpoint_contract.deployment: only model_state_dict is exported/deployed; projector is discarded

paired_bootstrap.scan_unit: 108 paired case deltas resampled with replacement
paired_bootstrap.subject_unit: mean case Dice within each of50 subjects, then50 paired subject deltas resampled with replacement
paired_bootstrap.point_gate: integer hits >=100 of108, equal to KD200 101 hits minus one

source_boundaries: paper Eq5 generally includes negative Conv; official binary Polyp comments omit it and project freezes the binary no-negative-Conv path
official code freezes the complete EfficientNet image_encoder while later conv_embed/decoder remain trainable; project trains full SegResNet in both arms
paper binary supervised loss is BCEWithLogits, official Polyp uses weighted BCE plus weighted IoU, project retains historical DiceCE for single-factor control
paper does not specify KIS/KAS stage lengths; project 32-epoch stage2 continuation is preregistered adaptation
official batch-global cosine is replaced before execution by per-volume cosine with eps/logsumexp stability
